name: corsair_captain_treasure_pays_for_your_spell
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")' Corsair Captain enters under seat 0: one Treasure, seat 0's. With no other mana, seat 0 casts Giant Growth on its Deckhand, tapping and sacrificing the Treasure for {G}: the Deckhand (2/2, 3/3 with the Captain) is 6/6 and the Treasure is gone. Only the Treasure's controller could pay with it.
